Put your mental model to the test.

Three quick scenarios. Make a prediction, get an explanation, then explore it in the lab.

01 · FUNDAMENTALS

Which recipe version gets saved?

You edit the recipe again after staging it. Which recipe content will the next commit save?

02 · REMOTES

Fetch or pull?

You edited your own recipe on GitHub and want to inspect that update before changing your computer’s copy. What do you run?

03 · SOLO RECOVERY

Undo without surprises

A recipe mistake is already saved on your GitHub repository. How do you undo it while keeping the earlier versions?
